mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a comfortable 76 degrees at Firemans Park with the moon currently in a Waning Gibbous phase.
The Verona Police Department reminds residents that they can now access traffic crash reports through crashdocs.org, ten days after an incident occurs.
There is plenty to do in our city, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by various trivia nights starting tomorrow at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Macs.
During a traffic stop on July 31, officers discovered marijuana and drug paraphernalia, leading to citations for the driver and passenger.
Today's flavor at Culvers is the decadent Chocolate Covered Strawberry. Don't forget that you can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Firemans Park between 11 AM and 2 PM today.
